async def act(page):
    """
    Add color Blue for sizes S and M to the product "Frankie Sweatshirt".

    Strategy:
    - Navigate (relative) to the Manage Products grid.
    - Locate and open the product edit page for "Frankie Sweatshirt" (attempt direct link or search by Name).
    - Open the Associated / Configurations area (try multiple possible tab/button names).
    - Attempt to run the Create Configurations / add associated products flow and set Color=Blue and Size=S/M.
    - Save the product (final action expected to navigate/save changes).

    Notes:
    - All interactions use accessibility selectors (page.get_by_role and .select_option) only.
    - No knowledge-base helper functions were available, so none are called.
    """
    # 1) Go to Manage Products grid (relative URL)
    await page.goto("/index.php/admin/catalog_product/index/")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # 2) Try to open the product edit page for "Frankie Sweatshirt"
    opened_product = False
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("link", name="Frankie Sweatshirt").click()
        opened_product = True
    except Exception:
        # Try searching by Name filter then clicking the product link in results
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Name").fill("Frankie Sweatshirt")
        except Exception:
            # If a textbox with accessible name "Name" isn't present, ignore and continue
            pass
        # Try to trigger search if a Search button exists
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
        except Exception:
            # Some grids auto-refresh or use other controls; continue regardless
            pass
        # Wait for results to load
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        # Try again to click the product link
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("link", name="Frankie Sweatshirt").click()
            opened_product = True
        except Exception:
            # Try a partial match link (e.g., name contains "Frankie")
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("link", name="Frankie").click()
                opened_product = True
            except Exception:
                opened_product = False

    # If we didn't manage to open the product, stop here (nothing else we can reliably do)
    if not opened_product:
        return

    # Wait for product edit page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # 3) Open the Associated/Configurations section/tab if present
    assoc_tab_names = [
        "Associated Products",
        "Associated Products / Variations",
        "Associated",
        "Configurations",
        "Configurable Product Variations",
        "Associated Items",
        "Product Variations",
    ]
    assoc_opened = False
    for name in assoc_tab_names:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("tab", name=name).click()
            assoc_opened = True
            break
        except Exception:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("link", name=name).click()
                assoc_opened = True
                break
            except Exception:
                try:
                    await page.get_by_role("button", name=name).click()
                    assoc_opened = True
                    break
                except Exception:
                    continue
    # small pause for UI to render if a section was opened
    if assoc_opened:
        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)

    # 4) Try to trigger a Create Configurations / Add product flow to add the Blue color for sizes S and M
    create_names = [
        "Create Configurations",
        "Create Configurations...",
        "Create Products",
        "Create Product",
        "Add Product",
        "Add New Product",
        "Add",
    ]
    create_triggered = False
    for btn in create_names:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=btn).click()
            create_triggered = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue

    # Wait briefly for modal/flow UI
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

    # 5) Attempt to create/assign two variations: Size S with Color Blue, Size M with Color Blue.
    # We'll try to set comboboxes named "Color" and "Size" at the form level, and repeat for S and M.
    for size in ["S", "M"]:
        # If there's a UI to pick attribute values for a new row, try to add a new row first
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Add").click()
        except Exception:
            # fallback: try a more explicit name
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("button", name="Add New Product").click()
            except Exception:
                # If no add button, continue and attempt to set comboboxes directly
                pass

        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)

        # Try to set Size and Color comboboxes (use select_option by visible option name when possible)
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Size").select_option(label=size)
        except Exception:
            # ignore if not present
            pass
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Color").select_option(label="Blue")
        except Exception:
            # ignore if not present
            pass

        # Some UIs require clicking an Apply/Save per-row
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Apply").click()
        except Exception:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
            except Exception:
                pass

        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)

    # 6) Final action: Save the main product (this likely navigates away / persists changes) - make this the last action
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    except Exception:
        # try alternative Save labels
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Continue Edit").click()
        except Exception:
            # If Save button not found via role, give up silently
            return
    # Wait for save/navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

async def act(page):
    """
    Add color Blue for sizes S and M to the product "Frankie Sweatshirt".

    Strategy:
    - Navigate (relative) to the Manage Products grid.
    - Locate and open the product edit page for "Frankie Sweatshirt" (attempt direct link or search by Name).
    - Open the Associated / Configurations area (try multiple possible tab/button names).
    - Attempt to run the Create Configurations / add associated products flow and set Color=Blue and Size=S/M.
    - Save the product (final action expected to navigate/save changes).

    Notes:
    - All interactions use accessibility selectors (page.get_by_role and .select_option) only.
    - No knowledge-base helper functions were available, so none are called.
    """
    # 1) Go to Manage Products grid (relative URL)
    await page.goto("/index.php/admin/catalog_product/index/")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # 2) Try to open the product edit page for "Frankie Sweatshirt"
    opened_product = False
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("link", name="Frankie Sweatshirt").click()
        opened_product = True
    except Exception:
        # Try searching by Name filter then clicking the product link in results
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Name").fill("Frankie Sweatshirt")
        except Exception:
            # If a textbox with accessible name "Name" isn't present, ignore and continue
            pass
        # Try to trigger search if a Search button exists
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
        except Exception:
            # Some grids auto-refresh or use other controls; continue regardless
            pass
        # Wait for results to load
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        # Try again to click the product link
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("link", name="Frankie Sweatshirt").click()
            opened_product = True
        except Exception:
            # Try a partial match link (e.g., name contains "Frankie")
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("link", name="Frankie").click()
                opened_product = True
            except Exception:
                opened_product = False

    # If we didn't manage to open the product, stop here (nothing else we can reliably do)
    if not opened_product:
        return

    # Wait for product edit page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # 3) Open the Associated/Configurations section/tab if present
    assoc_tab_names = [
        "Associated Products",
        "Associated Products / Variations",
        "Associated",
        "Configurations",
        "Configurable Product Variations",
        "Associated Items",
        "Product Variations",
    ]
    assoc_opened = False
    for name in assoc_tab_names:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("tab", name=name).click()
            assoc_opened = True
            break
        except Exception:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("link", name=name).click()
                assoc_opened = True
                break
            except Exception:
                try:
                    await page.get_by_role("button", name=name).click()
                    assoc_opened = True
                    break
                except Exception:
                    continue
    # small pause for UI to render if a section was opened
    if assoc_opened:
        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)

    # 4) Try to trigger a Create Configurations / Add product flow to add the Blue color for sizes S and M
    create_names = [
        "Create Configurations",
        "Create Configurations...",
        "Create Products",
        "Create Product",
        "Add Product",
        "Add New Product",
        "Add",
    ]
    create_triggered = False
    for btn in create_names:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=btn).click()
            create_triggered = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue

    # Wait briefly for modal/flow UI
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

    # 5) Attempt to create/assign two variations: Size S with Color Blue, Size M with Color Blue.
    # We'll try to set comboboxes named "Color" and "Size" at the form level, and repeat for S and M.
    for size in ["S", "M"]:
        # If there's a UI to pick attribute values for a new row, try to add a new row first
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Add").click()
        except Exception:
            # fallback: try a more explicit name
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("button", name="Add New Product").click()
            except Exception:
                # If no add button, continue and attempt to set comboboxes directly
                pass

        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)

        # Try to set Size and Color comboboxes (use select_option by visible option name when possible)
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Size").select_option(label=size)
        except Exception:
            # ignore if not present
            pass
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Color").select_option(label="Blue")
        except Exception:
            # ignore if not present
            pass

        # Some UIs require clicking an Apply/Save per-row
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Apply").click()
        except Exception:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
            except Exception:
                pass

        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)

    # 6) Final action: Save the main product (this likely navigates away / persists changes) - make this the last action
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    except Exception:
        # try alternative Save labels
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Continue Edit").click()
        except Exception:
            # If Save button not found via role, give up silently
            return
    # Wait for save/navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
